title: ID0417982-DC/Si-D/TR-[MP / S4 170003523] Fast shutdown check error
description:
Reported behavior/issue:
All of the converter groups are off.
Root cause: PowerConverter E4 - AC Open Phase
Solution: L1-N = 5V → fix upstream
On DAMEX Sanctioned List: No
Warranty Status: Active
